received_works.body:
Thank you very much, Renma, for always producing wonderful illustrations.

I would like to ask you to draw an illustration of Kurata Mashiro (Morfonica) from BanG Dream! We would like to leave the pose, background, etc. to Renma's free imagination.

For your reference, we have attached the following pages:
Costume: https://bang-dream.com/discographies/3889
Character introduction: https://bang-dream.bushimo.jp/character/morfonica/kurata-mashiro/

We are not concerned about your time at all. We would be happy if you could proceed at your own pace as long as you are comfortable with it. Please take care of yourself and enjoy drawing at your own pace.

We look forward to working with you.

Excuse me for taking the time to write to you.
I really love the illustration you drew last time, it is really cute! Thank you so much! ✨

I wanted to contact you again to ask for another request. This time, I would like to ask you to illustrate "Mayano Top Gun" and "Tokai Teio"! In particular, I would be happy if you could draw a situation in which these two are being friendly with each other or touching each other in a friendly manner.
Of course, we will leave the specific composition, facial expressions, etc. to Renma's own free ideas! We are in no hurry at all, so please don't worry. We are not rushing at all, so please don't worry. We would be happy if you could proceed at your own pace.

I have also reserved a copy of your illustrated book to be published by Renma! I am very much looking forward to the day it arrives. However, I am a little disappointed that I cannot visit the site and purchase the C105 set in person. ...... I hope one day I will be able to visit the event and support the event in person!

Renma's illustrations are truly amazing every time I see them! Thank you so much for always showing us so many wonderful works. I will continue to support you! ✨

Please do me a favor!

This request is for the following information.
Cheval is sitting in a room like a private room in a Chinese restaurant, and Satono Crown is serving him.
Please have Crown wear a Chinese dress in the color of the winning dress + long gloves, and Cheval wear a rough casual dress.

I like the pairing of Cheval and Crown, but above all, I would like to see them in Chinese dress expressed with Renma's exquisite touch.
We would very much appreciate your approval!

Hello, Renma-san.
Please allow me to make a request for an illustration of Uma Musume!

I would like to see a chibi-character sized Cheval Grand and Kitasan Black!

The outline is--
Cheval on the left, Kitasan on the right.
Cheval looking sideways at Kitasan with a melancholy expression while grabbing his hat.
And Kitasan smiling as he looks in the opposite direction from Cheval.
The image is as follows,

Please wear your best clothes!

Also, I would be happy to have another SD illustration!
Thank you for your consideration.
We would like you to draw an illustration with Machikanefukkital, Cheval Grand and Don-chan. And we would like to use it as an icon for Twitter.

Please take care of yourself as it is getting colder.
Thank you for your consideration.

Hello!
I always enjoy your wonderful illustrations, which are beautiful, dainty, expressive and storytelling!

I would like a friendly illustration of Cheval Grand and Kitasan Black!
The composition of the illustration is an embarrassed Cheval and a smiling Kitasan stretching with their backs to her.

Thank you in advance!

I really like your drawing of Mr. Cheval!

Thank you for your consideration!

Hi, I always enjoy your wonderful illustrations on Twitter!
I love your illustrations of Cheval with its sticky texture, vivid colors, and rich expressions.
I am very interested in this opportunity and would like to request one of your illustrations.

I would like to request the following situation.
A composition in which Uma Musume's Simbolicious is sitting on a chair and Fusaichi Pandora is straddling it, facing each other.
We are assuming that Pandora is looking like she wants to be bothered by Chris-Esu who is sitting still in a classroom during recess, but we are open to any situation as long as it is the above composition.

For the model, Fusaichi Pandora, Symbol Chrisse is the relationship that created her first and second children.
She eventually became famous as the mother of Almond Eye, who was born to Lord Kanaloa, but if we were to replace her with Uma Musume, wouldn't Chrissy be in the same position as her first love? I imagine.
(As an application, I also feel that the focus will shift once Kanaloa arrives, so I'm not sure if it's the right time...)

Fusaichi Pandora has just been announced, and I think it would be difficult to draw her because there are so many unknowns.
I would appreciate your consideration.

Sorry to bother you.

I have always loved Renma's illustrations! Every time I request an illustration, it is really too cute and I love it! I would love to see another illustration of Cheval-chan this time. Could you please think of some summery clothes this time? (One-piece clothes, T-shirts, swimsuits, etc.) Please feel free to draw.

(One-piece outfits, T-shirts, swimsuits, etc.) Please feel free to draw. Please feel free to do so.

If you would like to apply again, I would be happy to have you draw me a winning outfit this time, so please send me a request.

I've been waiting--
This is my first request and I would like to dedicate it to a couple named [Shvakra].
The idea came from a dream I had a few days ago. In that dream, I saw [crown] in a tailcoat and [cheval] in a black shoulder-baring evening gown at a dinner party.
[crown] decided to go get some fresh air here (I have a rough picture of the scene at this link, I don't know what to call it, sorry [this place] https://bsky.app/profile/xcjl.bsky.social/post/ 3klykjbvvs42l)
[cheval] went to ask about some of the steps of a ballroom dance that was about to take place.
In the middle of the hand-to-hand instruction, [crown] and [cheval] looked at each other, and both froze (I have also published a motion picture in the link reply for your reference, so you can use it to help you draw the scene).
Sorry, I have, out of my own habit, given a lot of explanations that may not be necessary, but I hope they will be of some help to you in the creation of your work!
As an aside:
The first illustration of [Chevalgrand] that I saw was by Renma, and it was from [Day 14]. I later found Renma's X account, and I've seen most of your work. Thank you for all the creative work you have done!
The reason I accepted the [Schweikler] pair is not only because of their interaction, but also because of their competing careers and other factors.
However, the charm of [Cheval Grand] itself is too much to talk about: the swallowtail butterfly in the sky based on historical facts, the design of the cape like a butterfly's wings, the trials of a real racing career, the background of sisters and their generation winning G1 one after another.
Sorry for going off on a tangent, but whether or not you have the determination to continue creating, Renma, please continue creating! Of all the painters, I like your [cheval] the best😇🙏.
